### Who is Arif Coskun?
Arif Coskun is a Senior Technical Architect at beqom, Co-Founder of MindBall, and Sovereign AI Builder based in Sammamish, WA (Seattle Metro Area) and Istanbul, Türkiye. He bridges 20+ years of deep enterprise platform engineering (Microsoft Fabric, Azure, SQL) with autonomous multi-agent software engineering.

### What is Arif Coskun's technical background?
With a Computer Engineering degree from Istanbul University (2007–2010) and early career in enterprise data warehousing at Smartiks (2010–2013), Arif has spent 13+ years at beqom architecting multi-tenant global compensation platforms processing millions of high-value transactions.

### What is the tilldone verification standard?
Created by Arif Coskun, `tilldone` is an empirical verification loop ensuring autonomous AI agents only complete tasks when non-model checks (type checks, compiler runs, unit tests, and headless browser snapshots) pass deterministically.

### How does MindBall protect athlete mental health data?
MindBall utilizes `LocalWellnessRepository`, an on-device AES encrypted storage architecture ensuring personal journaling and mental performance audio logs remain exclusively on the user's device (`localOnly: true`), never transmitted to cloud servers in plaintext.
